checks: closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= opened_at
segment = 1 OR predecessor_id IS NOT NULL
state IN ('OPEN','COUNTING','VOID') OR (closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_reason IS NOT NULL)
state NOT IN ('APPROVED','POSTED') OR approved_by IS NOT NULL
state <> 'VOID' OR void_reason IS NOT NULL
approved_by IS NULL OR closed_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> closed_by
released_at IS NULL OR released_at >= assigned_at
state = 'ACTIVE' OR released_at IS NOT NULL
state <> 'HANDED_OVER' OR handed_to_id IS NOT NULL
label IS NULL OR label IN ('DAY','NIGHT')
resolved_by IS NULL OR (resolution IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(resolution)) >= 10)

status <> 'EXECUTED' OR no_shift_to_break
    OR (shift_closed_id IS NOT NULL AND shift_opened_id IS NOT NULL)
status <> 'EXECUTED' OR executed_at IS NOT NULL
status <> 'CANCELLED' OR cancelled_reason IS NOT NULL
old_price IS NULL OR old_price <> new_price
second_approver IS NULL OR second_approver <> authorised_by
cylinder_state IS NULL OR cylinder_state IN ('FULL','EMPTY')
NOT is_cylinder OR cylinder_state IS NOT NULL

CASE WHEN fn_dry_sign(kind) <> 0
         THEN signed_qty = qty * fn_dry_sign(kind)
         ELSE abs(signed_qty) = qty END
corrects_id IS NULL OR correction_note IS NOT NULL
kind NOT IN ('DAMAGE_OUT','EXPIRY_OUT','OWN_USE_OUT') OR note IS NOT NULL
approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> counted_by
counted_qty = book_qty OR variance_reason IS NOT NULL

CASE WHEN fn_movement_sign(kind) <> 0
         THEN signed_litres = litres * fn_movement_sign(kind)
         ELSE abs(signed_litres) = litres
    END
corrects_id IS NULL OR correction_note IS NOT NULL

(evidence = 'PRESENT' AND photo_url IS NOT NULL)
    OR (evidence = 'PENDING' AND photo_url IS NULL)
    OR (evidence = 'WAIVED'  AND evidence_reason IS NOT NULL)
kind <> 'SALE' OR unit_price IS NOT NULL
kind <> 'PUMP_TEST' OR pump_test_id IS NOT NULL
kind <> 'OWN_USE' OR own_use_id IS NOT NULL
approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> staff_id
status <> 'APPROVED' OR declared_at IS NOT NULL
entry <> 'SETTLEMENT' OR settlement IS NOT NULL
settlement IS DISTINCT FROM 'CREDIT'   OR credit_sale_id IS NOT NULL
settlement IS DISTINCT FROM 'DISCOUNT' OR discount_id IS NOT NULL
settlement IS DISTINCT FROM 'SHORTAGE' OR shortage_id IS NOT NULL

settlement IS NULL OR settlement NOT IN ('MOBILE_MONEY','CARD','VOUCHER')
    OR channel_id IS NOT NULL
method <> 'SALARY_DEDUCTION' OR (acknowledged AND evidence_url IS NOT NULL)

decant_ended_at IS NULL OR decant_started_at IS NULL
         OR decant_ended_at >= decant_started_at
status <> 'RECEIVED' OR seals_intact IS NOT NULL
status <> 'RECEIVED' OR decant_shift_id IS NOT NULL
rejected_litres = 0 OR rejection_reason IS NOT NULL
approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> counted_by
entry <> 'SALE' OR meter_event_id IS NOT NULL OR dry_sale_id IS NOT NULL
approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> recorded_by

(basis = 'METER' AND metered_litres IS NOT NULL)
    OR (basis = 'DIP' AND dipped_litres IS NOT NULL)

(meter_event_id    IS NOT NULL)::int
+ (delivery_line_id  IS NOT NULL)::int
+ (stock_count_id    IS NOT NULL)::int
+ (bulk_draw_id      IS NOT NULL)::int
+ (bulk_sale_id      IS NOT NULL)::int
+ (stock_transfer_id IS NOT NULL)::int
+ (corrects_id       IS NOT NULL)::int
+ (kind = 'OPENING_BALANCE')::int = 1

(shift_id IS NOT NULL AND nozzle_id IS NOT NULL AND bulk_sale_id IS NULL)
  
  OR (bulk_sale_id IS NOT NULL AND shift_id IS NULL AND nozzle_id IS NULL)
witnessed_by IS NULL OR witnessed_by <> recorded_by
label IS NULL OR label IN ('DAY', 'MID', 'NIGHT')

(voided_at IS NULL AND voided_by IS NULL AND void_reason IS NULL) OR
    (voided_at IS NOT NULL AND voided_by IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(void_reason)) > 0)
valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from

entry <> 'SETTLEMENT'
    OR (settlement = 'OVERAGE' AND amount > 0)
    OR settlement::text = 'PRICE_AGREEMENT'
    OR (settlement <> 'OVERAGE' AND amount < 0)
settlement IS NULL OR settlement::text <> 'PRICE_AGREEMENT' OR credit_sale_id IS NOT NULL
kind <> 'MOBILE_MONEY' OR channel_id IS NOT NULL
